description: The proxy request cleaning hot path performs redundant copy.deepcopy calls across proxy/steps/clean_payload.py and payload_cleaner.py.
goal: Eliminate redundant copy.deepcopy calls across src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/clean_payload.py and src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py so the proxy request cleaning hot path performs at most one defensive copy per mutated request (preserving ctx.flow.raw_request_data immutability without mutating caller input or copying twice across clean_payload -> payload_cleaner). Keep both modules strictly at or below 200 lines and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Add unit tests in tests/test_clean_payload_single_copy.py asserting at most one copy.deepcopy per mutated request and verifying caller input / raw request preservation, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Avoiding repeated deep copies on every proxied LLM request reduces per-request CPU/memory overhead while keeping request history intact.
acceptance_criteria: Hot-path proxy pipeline in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/clean_payload.py and src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py performs at most one defensive copy per mutated request without mutating raw_request_data.

tests/test_clean_payload_single_copy.py proves at most one defensive copy per mutated request and passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint with zero docstrings or comments and unchanged holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
